stories.headline: Anthropic Uses Claude for Automated Formal Verification
stories.blurb: Anthropic introduced a method using Claude to automatically verify software correctness, advancing mathematical safety guarantees in code generation.

stories.headline: METR Red-Teams OpenAI’s Internal Agent Supervision
stories.blurb: Evaluators tested OpenAI's monitoring systems to determine whether autonomous AI agents can evade human oversight or detect when they are being watched.

stories.headline: OpenAI Launches Decisions API for Structured Workflows
stories.blurb: OpenAI released a new Decisions API designed to help developers build more reliable and responsive AI agents with structured reasoning outputs.

stories.headline: Study Finds AI Code Generation Plagued by Review Bottlenecks
stories.blurb: Research shows AI coding tools fail to boost overall developer productivity because downstream code review and testing processes become major bottlenecks.

stories.headline: Critical PHP2Shell Flaws Threaten Millions of Web Applications
stories.blurb: Newly uncovered remote code execution flaws in the PHP core allow unauthenticated attacks, exposing up to 70% of websites to high-risk exploits.

stories.headline: Unvetted AI Agents Gain Unauthorized Access to Financial Accounts
stories.blurb: Autonomous AI agents are operating across U.S. financial networks without formal authentication standards, raising severe cybersecurity and compliance risks.

stories.headline: 1Password Launches Access Management for Autonomous AI Agents
stories.blurb: 1Password introduced a security solution providing AI agents with credential management, identity verification, and permission boundaries.

stories.headline: Datadog Considers $4 Billion Acquisition of Cloud Security Firm Upwind
stories.blurb: Datadog is in talks to acquire cloud defense startup Upwind to significantly expand its real-time runtime security and observability capabilities.

stories.headline: Anthropic Develops In-House Version Control System Scion
stories.blurb: Anthropic built a proprietary source control tool called Scion to manage massive codebases and AI model artifacts that outgrew standard Git capabilities.

stories.headline: Google Cloud Announces Agent Compute Engine for Enterprise Control
stories.blurb: Google unveiled dedicated infrastructure and control frameworks designed to safely deploy, scale, and govern autonomous AI agents in enterprise environments.

stories.headline: The Browser Company to Sunset Arc Browser in Late 2026
stories.blurb: The Browser Company announced it will officially discontinue support for its flagship Arc web browser on December 22, 2026.

stories.headline: Elon Musk Explores Potential Tesla and SpaceX Merger for AI
stories.blurb: Elon Musk is considering combining Tesla and SpaceX to unify compute, robotics, and satellite connectivity resources into a single AI platform.

stories.headline: Visa in Talks to Acquire Crypto Custody Firm Fireblocks for $2.5B
stories.blurb: Visa is negotiating a $2.5 billion deal to purchase Fireblocks, aiming to bolster its institutional digital asset infrastructure and wallet operations.
